summary: John's maternal 5th great-grandfather; father of Carmine Fiorillo. The tree's pedigree above him is unsupported.
bio: Tree: Domenico G. Fiorillo (1785-1849) + Maria Morrello (1786-1846); his parents Carmine G. Fiorillo (d. 1797) + unknown. Carmine's death act (San Mango Morti 1860 act 30) names his parents as the late Domenico Fiorillo and the late Vittoria Marrelli/Morelli, so the wife's given name in the tree is wrong (Maria vs Vittoria). Round 2: San Mango's parish stati delle anime 1674-1804 contain no Fiorillo at all; Domenico (1785) + Maria Morrello (1786) would have been listed in 1800/1804 and are not. The Fiorillos arrived in San Mango in the 1800s, and the pre-1800 pedigree belongs to another comune (perhaps Nocera Terinese, Martirano or Conflenti - speculative) or was copied from another family's tree. His Ancestry profile carries the unidentified coat of arms (black shield, silver rampant lion, crown, wreath).
